goal: Speed up wallet fast rescans using compact block filters by evaluating filters across multiple CPU cores
Reduces wait times from minutes to seconds when scanning long chain ranges or importing descriptors
reviewability: Ready to review now with no blockers
agreement: Strong support with multiple reviewers verifying substantial rescan speedups
Verified 4.5x to 6x speedups scaling across multiple worker threads (ismaelsadeeq)
Verified a 3x speedup on a non-SSD hard drive setup (l0rinc)
Concept approval after concern about cross-wallet threadpool sharing was resolved (rkrux)
